newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks rise on short-covering.

text.p: Japan's banking sector shares rose in Tuesday morning trade, lifted by short-covering, especially by foreign investors, brokers said.
As of 0052 GMT, Nippon Credit Bank Ltd was up five yen at 268, the most-heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with turnover of 8.76 million shares.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi added 50 yen to 2,150 with trade volume totalling 2.83 million shares, ranking third.
It was followed by Sumitomo Bank Ltd which rose 50 yen to 1,620, with 2.78 million shares traded.
